name: crypto.aes
doc: AES block cipher: AES-GCM authenticated encryption, CBC with PKCS#7 padding and raw blocks (hardware-accelerated where available).

items.name: CbcDecrypt
items.doc: CbcDecrypt decrypts CBC ciphertext and removes the PKCS#7 padding (checked in constant time).
items.summary: CbcDecrypt decrypts CBC ciphertext and removes the PKCS#7 padding (checked in constant time).

items.name: CbcDecryptRaw
items.doc: CbcDecryptRaw decrypts CBC ciphertext without removing padding.
items.summary: CbcDecryptRaw decrypts CBC ciphertext without removing padding.

items.name: CbcEncrypt
items.doc: CbcEncrypt encrypts plaintext in CBC mode with PKCS#7 padding (16-byte iv).
items.summary: CbcEncrypt encrypts plaintext in CBC mode with PKCS#7 padding (16-byte iv).

items.name: CbcEncryptRaw
items.doc: CbcEncryptRaw encrypts in CBC mode without padding; the length must be a multiple of 16.
items.summary: CbcEncryptRaw encrypts in CBC mode without padding; the length must be a multiple of 16.

items.name: GcmOpen
items.doc: GcmOpen decrypts and verifies the output of GcmSeal; a wrong key, nonce, aad or tag is an error.
items.summary: GcmOpen decrypts and verifies the output of GcmSeal; a wrong key, nonce, aad or tag is an error.

items.name: GcmSeal
items.doc: GcmSeal encrypts and authenticates plaintext with AES-GCM (16/24/32-byte key, 12-byte nonce); the result is the ciphertext followed by the 16-byte tag.
items.summary: GcmSeal encrypts and authenticates plaintext with AES-GCM (16/24/32-byte key, 12-byte nonce); the result is the ciphertext followed by the 16-byte tag.

items.name: HasHardware
items.doc: HasHardware reports whether AES-NI and carry-less multiplication are used.
items.summary: HasHardware reports whether AES-NI and carry-less multiplication are used.

items.name: Pkcs7Pad
items.doc: Pkcs7Pad appends PKCS#7 padding for a block size.
items.summary: Pkcs7Pad appends PKCS#7 padding for a block size.

items.name: Pkcs7Unpad
items.doc: Pkcs7Unpad removes PKCS#7 padding; invalid padding is an error.
items.summary: Pkcs7Unpad removes PKCS#7 padding; invalid padding is an error.
